job: Add files by dropping them or browsing.
purpose: A dashed, sunken area that is also a button: click or press Enter to browse, or drop files. Dragging over it turns the line accent. Accepted files appear as rows in fd-filelist with progress, status and size. fd:files is cancelable so your app can run the upload and report progress with setFileProgress(); data-max-mb and accept reject files that do not fit.
useWhen: People attach one or several files, such as a sitemap, a CSV or a document.
Upload progress and per-file errors should show as rows.

avoidWhen.when: One small file is chosen as part of a plain form and no progress is needed.
The upload is an image avatar.
Files are only listed, not added.

states.name: dragover
states.how: data-state="dragover" while files are dragged over it

states.name: error
states.how: data-state="error" on a file row, with a reason in .fd-file-status

variants.useWhen: A compact one-line dropzone in a form row.

parts.role: The drop area; a label around the file input.
The icon that lifts on drag.
Progress, ready or the reason it failed.
